_readme: Feature verification list. Set a platform to true only after actually walking through the steps; do not edit or remove steps. browser = in a browser (including npm run test:e2e); windows / mac = the desktop app on real hardware. e2e names the automated test file, if any.

features.description: Import an .xlsx/.csv snippet sheet; invalid and duplicate rows are reported
steps: Import docs/samples/clipbox-test-snippets.csv
34 imported, 2 invalid rows, 1 duplicate reported

features.description: Copy puts the content on the clipboard and never clears it afterwards
steps: Open a snippet
Click 复制
Paste into another app

features.description: Switching entries: the new card expands, the old card folds away gradually, no white border flash
steps: Open entry 2
Click entry 5
The old card folds away in about 0.2 s

features.description: Company 话术 library: sync from an address or file adds new entries and updates untouched ones; edited entries keep the employee's text with a 公司版有更新 mark and a compare; dropped entries are only marked 公司已停用; nothing is deleted or overwritten
steps: Settings → 共享话术 → 选公司文件… docs/samples/shared-library-v1.json
Edit one company 话术, then sync v2
Open the marked 话术: choose 保留我的 or 用公司版

features.description: Fill in [variables]; with many variables the copy bar stays visible at the bottom
steps: Open a snippet with [variables]
Click 填写变量
Fill in and copy

features.description: Inline editing; 小提示 field up to 40 characters; save and copy
steps: Click 编辑
Change content and 小提示
Save

features.description: AI polish / tidy use the endpoint from Settings and can be undone
steps: Settings → AI: pick a preset, enter a key
保存并测试 reports success
Edit a snippet, click AI 润色, then 撤销

features.description: The API key is stored with OS encryption (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain) and only sent to the saved server
steps: Save a key in the desktop app
ai-key.json in the data folder shows no plain-text key

features.description: Create/rename/recolour/delete/drag-sort folders in Settings and the sidebar; standard snippet folders are fixed
steps: Settings → 目录: create three folders
Drag to reorder
Sidebar order matches

features.description: No keyboard shortcut hints and no modifier shortcuts anywhere
steps: No Ctrl/⌘ labels visible
Ctrl+E does nothing

features.description: (Removed by D-017: Windows has 图片 instead of 备注) Second section is 备注: plain text, no masking/reference/segments
steps: Switch to 备注
Add an entry
Open it: content is shown directly

features.description: Second section is 秘密 with masking, hold-to-reveal and copy reference
steps: Switch to 秘密
Add an entry
Hold to reveal, copy reference

features.description: Full window min 680×620; mini window 360×440 always on top, position remembered
steps: Shrink the window to its minimum
Switch to mini
Quit and reopen

features.description: Tray icon opens the mini window; close button goes to tray or quits per Settings
steps: Click the tray icon
After copying it hides per Settings
Click the window's close button

features.description: Windows only: closing can shrink the window to the taskbar (Settings), and clicking the taskbar icon brings it back; reopening from the tray, Start menu or a second launch restores a minimised window
steps: Settings → 点击窗口关闭按钮时 → 缩到任务栏
Click the window's close button
The window shrinks to the taskbar; click its icon to reopen

features.description: Silent launch at login (--hidden on Windows)
steps: Enable launch at login in Settings
Restart the computer
Only the tray icon appears, no window

features.description: Packaging: Windows NSIS installer; macOS arm64 .app only
steps: On Windows run npm run desktop:pack:win and install
On a Mac run npm run desktop:pack and open

features.description: Encrypted export/import of the snippet backup (excludes 备注/秘密)
steps: Settings → 导出话术备份
Clear, then import
Snippets are back

features.description: Encrypted export of the 秘密 section (macOS; 备注 on Windows was removed by D-017) to its own local file (no snippets); restored with 导入备份
steps: Settings → 导出备注备份 (导出秘密备份 on Mac)
Move the note to the trash
导入备份 → 覆盖: the note is back, snippets untouched

features.description: 图片 section: add (file, drop, paste), copy the picture as PNG, rename, search, delete with confirmation; stored encrypted on the device
steps: Switch to 图片 (Windows: 话术 | 图片; Mac: 话术 | 秘密 | 图片)
新增图片 → pick a PNG and a JPG
Click 复制 and paste into a chat app: the picture appears
改名, search by title, 删除 → confirm
Quit and reopen: the images are still there

features.description: 图片 16宫格: 4 square tiles per row, whole picture shown (no crop) with a 6% margin on frosted glass, copy button on each tile, tile click opens a full-width detail card, 宫格 | 列表 switch remembered per device, mini window grid
steps: Switch to 图片 with 10+ pictures
Four tiles per row, each picture fully visible; click the copy button on a tile and paste elsewhere
Click a tile: its card opens below the row; click again to close
Switch to 列表 and back; reload keeps the choice
Mini window: tiles in 4 columns, clicking one copies it

features.description: 图片 folders: create / rename / recolour / delete, move images between folders, filter, 未分类; deleting a folder keeps its images
steps: Switch to 图片
Click + next to 目录 and create 收款码
Open an image → 目录 → move it into 收款码
The folder count goes up; select the folder to see only its images
Delete the folder: the image is back in 未分类

features.description: Move to trash with undo; restore, delete permanently, auto-purge
steps: Delete an entry
Undo within 6 s
Restore from 回收站

features.description: System / light / dark theme
steps: Switch all three themes in Settings
